decision_conditions: The proposed front extensions and gable end roof extension, by virtue of its design and form would appear visually intrusive and incongruous in relation to the host building and the character and appearance of the surrounding area. The proposal is thereby contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD11, DMD13 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed front extensions and first floor rear extension, by virtue of their siting, bulk, projection and proximity to the site boundaries would give rise to an unneighbourly loss of privacy, sunlight and daylight, outlook, as perceived from neighbouring properties including Nos. 84A & 86 Clydesdale, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8 and DMD11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
